entries.en:
Jihli Aliapoh asks that you join her in celebrating the coming of Hatching<-->tide, a festival born from a vision bestowed on her by the Twelve Archons of yore; a vision that came to reality a twelvemoon prior. However, this year's event is to be no mere memorial, for Jihli has again been visited by the Archons: in her most recent dream, she saw adventurers in spriggan form following an auspicious spriggan, who guided them to a wondrous treasure. She bids you speak with her sylphic helper by the amphitheatre gates, so that you too might be transfigured into the shape of a spriggan, and bring her vision to life.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

entries.en:
The sorceress, a sylph in Lalafellin clothing, transfigures you into spriggan form with illusory magicks. She bids you remain in disguise as you hunt for Archon eggs around Old Gridania, and collect three of the cards contained within, that you might exchange them with Jihli for a special prize.

※If the transfiguration should fade, speak with the sylphic sorceress again to be changed back into spriggan form.

Revenez voir l'enchanteresse si vous reprenez accidentellement votre forme humaine.

entries.en: You deliver the Archon cards to Jihli Aliapoh, who is amazed to find a platinum card among your collection. She asks how you could have discovered the egg that contained this rarest of prizes, and you relate how an unusual spriggan holding a checkered egg drew your attention to it. Jihli is delighted to hear your news, recognizing the auspicious spriggan from her vision in your words. Convinced once more that the Archons' prophecy is coming true, she asks for your assistance in tracking down the auspicious spriggan, that he might guide you to the wondrous treasure of which the Archons spoke.
entries.fr: La Miqo'te a bondi de joie lorsqu'elle a appris qu'un spriggan vous avait montré où obtenir l'unique carte chance existant à sa con<->nais<->san<->ce. Pour elle aucun doute, il s'agit forcément du petit monstre porte-bonheur qu'elle a vu dans son rêve. Vous lui avez redonné du courage quand elle commençait justement à désespérer. Ne la laissez pas tomber, elle compte encore sur vous<nbsp>!

entries.en:
Why eggs, you ask? It is a strange history, but every word the truth. Some years back, the Twelve Archons of ages past blessed me with a vision. In my dream, they descended from the heavens atop vividly patterned eggs, and bid me ready the vessels for their return.
Every year since, my loyal band of Dreamers and I have painstakingly decorated eggs to match those from my vision, in the sure knowledge that one day they would summon the Archons to life. And would you believe that last year, the prophecy finally came to pass!

entries.en:
In my dream, the towns and fields of Eorzea were thronged with spriggans─the habitual enemies of Hatching<-->tide, who have bedeviled festivals past with their obsessive egg theft─but no nightmare, this. For they were not real spriggans, but adventurers in spriggan form!
All excepting one, that is─a mysterious auspicious spriggan, who guided the joyful masses to a glorious treasure!

entries.fr: Mais il y a quelque chose qui me tourmente... On a trouvé un moyen de transformer les gens, mais le sprrriggan porte-bonheur n'a toujours pas montré le bout de son nez.

「幸運のスプリガン」が、やっと来てくれたのね！
よかった……やっぱり、夢のとおりになったんだ。
entries.frMacro: Merrrveilleux<nbsp>! Ça veut dire que ce spécimen rare a enfin décidé de montrer le bout de ses grandes oreilles. Je savais que mon rêve allait se réaliser<nbsp>!

entries.en: After last year's successes, my Dreamers have quite convinced themselves that my vision would again come true, and have devoted themselves utterly to preparing this year's festivities. I could never have forgiven myself had my dream proved to be no more than a fantasy.
entries.fr: Tu sais, j'avais vraiment peur qu'on ne voie jamais ce spriggan. Tout le monde trrravaille dur pour que cet événement suive le cours de ma vision, alors ça aurait été dommage qu'il ne fasse pas une apparition...
entries.ja:
……実は私、すごく怖かったの。
私の見た夢を頼りに、みんな一生懸命がんばってるのに、
もし「幸運のスプリガン」が現れなかったら、どうしようって。

entries.en: But now the auspicious spriggan is discovered, and all is proceeding as the Archons of yore revealed it to me. If we can only keep track of the creature, he is sure to lead us to the wondrous treasure of which the prophecy spoke.
entries.fr: Mais tu m'as redonné espoirrr. Avec cette magnifique créature pour nous guider, je sais que tout va bien se passer<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
だけど、あなたのおかげで自信が戻ったわ！
夢のお告げのとおりに、お祭りを続ければ、
「幸運のスプリガン」が、みんなを導いてくれるはず……！

entries.en: Hatching<-->tide is about to begin in earnest! If I might further impose on your kindness, could I ask for your assistance with the next stage of proceedings? Come and speak to me again whenever you are ready. Until then, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>, may the Archons of yore bless you and keep you.

エグ、エグ、エグル、エッグルルルゥ～ッ♪
